column1: # Keep one row for every screen/state in docs/legacy-functional-inventory.md.
# runtime_owner: framework that renders the ordinary reachable route today, or none for an explicitly deferred route.
# migration_state: accepted, migrating, legacy, or deferred.
# accepted requires ordinary-route wiring, required behavior, relevant tests, and >=90% visual similarity.
